fragmentation.eligibility: A track is eligible when it has an original candidate prediction window and at least one interior location in an exact-cadence run where the removed observations intersect an 8-step candidate history. Every track, including ineligible tracks and its reason, is listed per seed.
fragmentation.future_crossing_policy: Windows are retained based only on the observed history fragment. Original ground-truth futures may span removed samples or a synthetic ID boundary.
fragmentation.location_control: For a given seed and track, the selected break start is shared across all severities; eligible locations are chosen to support the three-step interruption.
fragmentation.sampled_step_policy: Remove the configured consecutive sampled observations from the source track before window construction; no stitching or interpolation.
fragmentation.selection: One reproducibly selected interior interruption per eligible original (scene, pedestrian_id) track; seed-specific deterministic choice over valid locations that intersect at least one candidate observed history.
fragmentation.track_id_policy: Preserve (scene, pedestrian_id) as ground-truth provenance. The first fragment keeps the original integer ID; the subsequent fragment gets a new scene-local synthetic integer ID recorded separately from scoring IDs.
